full_judgment:
2. Plaintiffs case, in brief, is that he purchased 0.50 acres of land i.e. 0.21 acres in Dag No. 500 and 0.29 acres in Dag No. 501 of Khatian No. 308 from defendant No. 1 by kabala dated 17.11.75 for a consideration of Tk. 2000'00. On the same day the plaintiff executed an agreement for reconveyance in favour of defendant No. 1 of the land within the stipulated time as embodied in the Ekramama. Defendant No. 1 requested plaintiff for return of the land as per the agreement for reconveyance to which the plaintiff agreed and the agreement of reconveyance was written. But fraudulently defendant No.1 in collusion with the scribe entered into the document another 1.00 acre of land i.e. 0.30 acres in Dag No. 343 and 0.70 acres in Dag No. 720 of Khatian No. 219 which the plaintiff purchased by a kabala from the son of defendant No. 1 on 17.5.66. It is alleged that for consideration of Taka 2,000'00 1.50 acres of land are being taken fraudulently by defendant No. 1 by the document of reconveyance executed and registered on 17.3.77. Plaintiff having come to know of this fraudulent act of defendant No. 1 filed this suit for cancellation of the document dated 17.3.77. 

 The lower appellate Court considered certain facts of the case, such as if the plaintiff would have actually transferred 1.50 acres of land then the price would have been Taka 2,500'00, whereas the price shown in the kabala was only Tk. 2,000'00. This also clearly shows that the plaintiff in fact intended to return 0.05 acres of land to defendant No. 1 by the disputed kabala. The learned Subordinate Judge also found that if the transaction of 1.00 acre of land to defendant No. 1 would have been a genuine one then the reconveyance in respect of 1.00 acre of land would be in the name of defendant No. 1 only and further the lower appellate Court also found that the plea of benami has not at all been proved and that in the facts of the present case it was easy to insert figure 1 before 0.50 acre of land. The lower appellate Court on consideration of the materials on record found that insertion 1.50 acres of land in the impugned kabala dated 17.3.77 was done fraudulently by defendant No. 1 and consequently rectified and corrected the impugned kabala by striking off 1.00 acre of land from the kabala in khatian No. 219.
